import pytest

def is_palindrome(s: str) -> bool:
    return s == s[::-1]

@pytest.mark.parametrize("s, expected", [
    ("", True),                    # empty
    ("a", True),                   # single
    ("racecar", True),             # palindrome
    ("hello", False),              # non-palindrome
    ("Racecar", False),            # mixed case
])
def test_is_palindrome(s, expected):
    assert is_palindrome(s) == expected
